# aiup

> A local-first macOS terminal catalog for reviewed AI and developer tools.

aiup scans local tool state, updates installed managed tools, and provides an fzf interface for deliberate install, remove, adoption, documentation, and catalog actions. Version 2026.08.27-02 contains 81 reviewed entries. macOS 14+, Bash 3+, Python 3, and curl are required; fzf is required infrastructure managed through Homebrew.

Local inventory is never uploaded. A normal public invocation refreshes and validates the runtime plus matching catalog manifest from GitHub before it runs and does not execute an offline stale-cache fallback. Selected maintenance actions may contact GitHub, Homebrew, npm, uv, or the applicable vendor. aiup does not invoke sudo itself, although upstream installers may request administrator authentication.

Linux and Windows are not implemented. There is no tagged 1.0 release or packaged installer.
